title: u4-timeline-drag: full drag interactions on timeline bars
scope: Pointer-capture drag on bars (move both dates) and edge handles (resize start/end; dragging an open-ended terminus sets a real end date), per-zoom snapping from the u1 drag math, drag preview via direct style updates (no transitions), Escape cancels, drag-vs-click threshold (click still opens the popover), auto-scroll at window edges, commits through u3's existing onCommitDates/handleCommitDates seam (deferred-commit undo toast), archive-trap confirm when a drag would newly expire a project, touch policy per seed (long-press to drag; native panning wins otherwise), reduced-motion + a11y (popover remains the keyboard path), tests for snap/commit/cancel logic. Also closes verifier FINDING 1: the populated-state toolbar row in ProjectsTimeline.tsx gets the same flex-wrap treatment as the empty state.
criteria: Bar drag moves both dates; edge handles resize start/end; open-ended terminus drag sets a real end date; per-zoom snapping uses pxToSnappedDayDelta from the engine (no new date math)
Drag-vs-click threshold preserved: a plain click still opens the popover; Escape cancels an in-flight drag with full visual revert
Commits reuse u3's onCommitDates/handleCommitDates deferred-commit undo path; a drag that newly expires a project triggers the archive-trap confirm before committing
Auto-scroll engages near scroller edges during drag; touch: long-press initiates drag, otherwise native horizontal panning is untouched
No width/position transitions during drag (direct style updates only); reduced motion respected; both themes; §14/§16 canon on every changed line
Populated-state toolbar row wraps at narrow widths (verifier FINDING 1 closed)
Scoped tests green (drag logic: snap, commit, cancel, threshold, archive-trap) plus u3's test files and the 71 engine tests; npx tsc --noEmit clean
